defaultMetaTitle: Arachnology at AMNH | Scorpion Systematics Research Group | Lorenzo Prendini
defaultMetaDescription: The Arachnology Lab in the Division of Invertebrate Zoology at the American Museum of Natural History focuses on the taxonomy, phylogeny and biogeography of scorpions and related arachnid orders. Lorenzo Prendini is the Curator of Arachnida and Myriapoda at the American Museum of Natural History.
